mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dms_wechat_logistics_follow_task (tenant_id,order_id,shipment_id,user_id,status,attempt_count) VALUES (#{tenantId},#{orderId},#{shipmentId},#{userId},'PENDING',0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE user_id=VALUES(user_id), status=CASE WHEN status IN ('SUCCESS','SENDING') THEN status ELSE 'PENDING' END, attempt_count=CASE WHEN status IN ('SUCCESS','SENDING') THEN attempt_count ELSE 0 END, next_retry_time=NULL,error_code=NULL,update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM dms_wechat_logistics_follow_task WHERE ((status IN ('PENDING','RETRYABLE') AND (next_retry_time IS NULL OR next_retry_time <= #{now})) OR (status='SENDING' AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until < #{now}))) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE dms_wechat_logistics_follow_task SET status='SENDING',lease_owner=#{owner},lease_until=#{leaseUntil}, attempt_count=attempt_count+1,update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND ((status IN ('PENDING','RETRYABLE') AND (next_retry_time IS NULL OR next_retry_time <= #{now})) OR (status='SENDING' AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until < #{now})))
mapper.select: SELECT FROM dms_wechat_logistics_follow_task WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND order_id=#{orderId} AND shipment_id=#{shipmentId} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('PENDING','RETRYABLE','SENDING') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) backlog_count, MIN(CASE WHEN status IN ('PENDING','RETRYABLE','SENDING') THEN create_time END) oldest_time, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status='PERMANENT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) failure_count FROM dms_wechat_logistics_follow_task
mapper.update: UPDATE dms_wechat_logistics_follow_task SET status='SUCCESS',payload_digest=#{payloadDigest}, error_code=NULL,registered_time=#{now},lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL,next_retry_time=NULL, update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND lease_owner=#{owner} AND status='SENDING'

UPDATE dms_wechat_logistics_follow_task SET status='RETRYABLE',next_retry_time=#{nextRetryTime},error_code=#{errorCode}, lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL,update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND lease_owner=#{owner} AND status='SENDING'

UPDATE dms_wechat_logistics_follow_task SET status=#{status},error_code=#{errorCode},registered_time=#{now}, lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL,next_retry_time=NULL,update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND lease_owner=#{owner} AND status='SENDING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dms_wechat_logistics_follow_task (tenant_id,order_id,shipment_id,user_id,status,attempt_count,payload_digest,registered_time) VALUES (#{tenantId},#{orderId},#{shipmentId},#{userId},'SUCCESS',0,#{payloadDigest},#{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE user_id=VALUES(user_id),status='SUCCESS',payload_digest=VALUES(payload_digest), error_code=NULL,registered_time=VALUES(registered_time),next_retry_time=NULL, lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL,update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.update: UPDATE dms_wechat_logistics_follow_task SET status='SKIPPED',error_code='WAYBILL_CANCELLED',registered_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL,next_retry_time=NULL,update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND order_id=#{orderId} AND shipment_id=#{shipmentId} AND status NOT IN ('SUCCESS','SENDING')

UPDATE dms_wechat_logistics_follow_task SET status='SUSPENDED',next_retry_time=NULL,lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL, error_code='WAYBILL_CANCELLATION_PENDING',update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND order_id=#{orderId} AND shipment_id=#{shipmentId} AND status NOT IN ('SUCCESS','SENDING')

UPDATE dms_wechat_logistics_follow_task SET status='PENDING',next_retry_time=NULL,error_code=NULL,update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND order_id=#{orderId} AND shipment_id=#{shipmentId} AND status='SUSPENDED'
